lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg2Co6O8 (MgCo3O4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-42m (No. 121), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for all three elements: Co and Mg centers each have six O neighbors, while O centers have six geometric neighbors (four Co and two Mg). The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner- and edge-sharing between Co and Mg octahedra and between O-centered octahedra.
